change a type

cases.name: make a column nullable
cases.output: ALTER TABLE "main"."customers" ALTER COLUMN "balance" DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE "main"."customers" ALTER COLUMN "display_name" TYPE VARCHAR(150);
